From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

English

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈɛdɪtɪŋ/
  • Audio (US):(file)

Verb

[edit]
English Wikipedia has an article on:
editing
Wikipedia

editing

  1. present participle and gerund of edit

Noun

[edit]

editing (plural editings)

  1. An act or instance of something being edited.
    Synonym: (sound recording, cinematography) montage
    • 2012, Betty R. Pritchett, The Indian Summer of Mary Margaret Masters:
      To her, I credit three complete editings, numerous arguments and discussions over an extended period of time, and the incalculable benefit of her great knowledge and love of the English language.

Derived terms

[edit]
  • analytical editing
  • copy editing
  • evil editing
  • hyperediting
  • immunoediting
  • line editing
  • nonlinear editing
  • peer editing

Translations

[edit]
an act or instance of something being edited
  • Bulgarian: редакти́ране (bg) n (redaktírane)
  • Catalan: edició (ca) f
  • Chinese:
    Mandarin: 編輯 / 编辑 (zh) (biānjí)
  • Esperanto: muntado, redaktado
  • Finnish: editointi (fi), (cinematography) leikkaus (fi)
  • French: rédaction (fr) f
  • German: Bearbeitung (de) f
  • Irish: eagarthóireacht f
  • Italian: redazione (it) f, (film, etc.) montaggio (it) m
  • Japanese: 編集 (ja) (へんしゅう, henshū)
  • Persian: ویرایش (fa) (virâyeš)
  • Portuguese: edição (pt) f
  • Russian: редакти́рование (ru) n (redaktírovanije)
  • Scottish Gaelic: deasachadh m
  • Spanish: (cinematography) montaje (es) m, edición (es) f, editaje m (Spain)
  • Swedish: redaktion (sv) c, redigering (sv) c
  • Welsh: (the act) golygu (cy) m, (an instance) golygiad m
